newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish operators cut DEM/FIM spread to 20 pips.
newsitem.headline: Finnish operators cut DEM/FIM spread to 20 pips.

text.p: Foreign exchange interbank operators in Finland on Monday morning reduced the bid-ask spread on the DEM/FIM cross rate to 0.0020 markka from 0.0030 markka, dealers said.
The change aimed at boosting trading and foreign interest in the Finnish markka, they said.
"Maybe this way we can increase foreign interest in the market," said one chief forex dealer.
Another chief dealer said the change had been discussed for a long time and that some foreign operators had also agreed on the change.
"We'll see whether others will also follow," he said.

He said it had become difficult for banks to make any money on the very stable markka forex market and that competition had forced banks to quote narrower spreads to clients than in interbank dealings.
